description: This source file defines utility functions for handling date and time conversions, parsing, and rebasing within Apache Spark, including timezone handling, string parsing, and conversions between different date/time representations.

classes.name: SparkDateTimeUtils
classes.description: A trait providing static utility methods for date and time conversions, parsing, and timezone handling in Spark.

methods.name: getZoneId
methods.description: Parses a timezone string and returns a ZoneId object, supporting various formats including +/-h:mm.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns a TimeZone object for a given timezone string.

methods.name: anyToDays
methods.description: Converts a Java object (Date or LocalDate) to days since epoch.

methods.name: anyToMicros
methods.description: Converts a Java object (Timestamp, Instant, LocalDateTime) to microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: nanosToMicros
methods.description: Converts nanoseconds to microseconds.

methods.name: microsToMillis
methods.description: Converts microseconds since epoch to milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: millisToMicros
methods.description: Converts milliseconds since epoch to microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: microsToNanos
methods.description: Converts microseconds since epoch to nanoseconds.

methods.name: microsToInstant
methods.description: Creates an Instant object from microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: instantToMicros
methods.description: Converts an Instant to microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: instantToNanosOfDay
methods.description: Calculates nanoseconds since midnight for an Instant in a given timezone.

methods.name: truncateTimeToPrecision
methods.description: Truncates nanoseconds to a specified fractional second precision.

methods.name: convertTz
methods.description: Converts a timestamp from one timezone to another.

methods.name: getLocalDateTime
methods.description: Gets local date-time parts of an instant in a specific timezone.

methods.name: microsToLocalDateTime
methods.description: Converts microseconds since epoch to LocalDateTime in UTC.

methods.name: localDateTimeToMicros
methods.description: Converts LocalDateTime to microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: localDateToDays
methods.description: Converts LocalDate to days since epoch.

methods.name: daysToLocalDate
methods.description: Converts days since epoch to LocalDate.

methods.name: microsToDays
methods.description: Converts microseconds since epoch to days since epoch in a specific timezone.

methods.name: daysToMicros
methods.description: Converts days since epoch to microseconds since epoch in a specific timezone.

methods.name: localTimeToNanos
methods.description: Converts LocalTime to nanoseconds within the day.

methods.name: nanosToLocalTime
methods.description: Converts nanoseconds within the day to LocalTime.

methods.name: fromJavaDate
methods.description: Converts java.sql.Date to days since epoch, rebasing from hybrid to Gregorian calendar.

methods.name: toJavaDate
methods.description: Converts days since epoch to java.sql.Date, rebasing from Gregorian to hybrid calendar.

methods.name: toJavaTimestamp
methods.description: Converts microseconds since epoch to java.sql.Timestamp, rebasing from Gregorian to hybrid calendar.

methods.name: toJavaTimestamp
methods.description: Overloaded: converts microseconds since epoch to java.sql.Timestamp with timezone support.

methods.name: toJavaTimestampNoRebase
methods.description: Converts microseconds since epoch to java.sql.Timestamp without rebasing.

methods.name: fromJavaTimestamp
methods.description: Converts java.sql.Timestamp to microseconds since epoch, rebasing from hybrid to Gregorian calendar.

methods.name: fromJavaTimestamp
methods.description: Overloaded: converts java.sql.Timestamp to microseconds since epoch with timezone support.

methods.name: fromJavaTimestampNoRebase
methods.description: Converts java.sql.Timestamp to microseconds since epoch without rebasing.

methods.name: stringToDate
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String date into days since epoch, supporting various ISO formats.

methods.name: stringToDateAnsi
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String date and throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: parseTimestampString
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String timestamp into segments, timezone, and time-only flag.

methods.name: stringToTimestamp
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String timestamp into microseconds since epoch, considering timezone.

methods.name: stringToTimestampAnsi
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String timestamp and throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: stringToTimestampWithoutTimeZone
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String timestamp into microseconds, ignoring timezone if allowed.

methods.name: stringToTime
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String time into nanoseconds since midnight, supporting AM/PM.

methods.name: stringToTimeAnsi
methods.description: Parses a UTF8String time and throws an error if invalid.
